- Make sure you are looking at the latest edits at: https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/tree/master/4.0
- When you reference requirements, please include them as a link, similarly to this:

OTHER NOTES:
- Please do not open a pull request without first opening an associated issue.
- Please carry out all discussion in the associated issue only.
-->
(just issue for references)

My own tasks, so you know that there is work in progress with those:

* [x] update labels in _bleeding edge_ compared to released v4.0.3 (at the moment those are compared to v4.0.2)
* [x] more detailed description of used labels and why we use labels

comments.body: I just renamed the title here for clarity, thank you for this. The label system ended up being super useful and I appreciate it.
May I suggest that you remove your note on 4.04 or 4.1, I really would not like to suggest those in public.

title: Update bleeding edge labels for 5.0 release
